<a name="KeyID"></a>
## func [KeyID](<https://github.com/brii26/release-signer/blob/main/pkg/keys/keys.go#L147>)

```go
func KeyID(pub crypto.PublicKey) (string, error)
```

KeyID return hex\_lower\(SHA\-256\(DER SPKI\)\), DER di\-export ulang, jadi format PEM tidak berpengaruh.

<details><summary>Example</summary>
<p>

keyid = SHA\-256 hex lowercase dari DER SPKI, jadi selalu 64 karakter.

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/brii26/release-signer/pkg/keys"
	"github.com/brii26/release-signer/pkg/profile"
)

func main() {
	signer, err := keys.Generate(profile.ECDSA)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	id, err := keys.KeyID(signer.Public())
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(len(id))
}
```

#### Output

```
64
```

</p>
</details>

<a name="ParsePrivatePEM"></a>
## func [ParsePrivatePEM](<https://github.com/brii26/release-signer/blob/main/pkg/keys/keys.go#L64>)

```go
func ParsePrivatePEM(data []byte) (crypto.Signer, profile.Profile, error)
```

ParsePrivatePEM parse PKCS\#8 PEM, return signer dan profile, tipe atau parameter tak didukung ditolak.

<details><summary>Example</summary>
<p>

Generate key pair, export private key ke PKCS\#8 PEM, lalu baca balik.

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/brii26/release-signer/pkg/keys"
	"github.com/brii26/release-signer/pkg/profile"
)

func main() {
	signer, err := keys.Generate(profile.Ed25519)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	pemBytes, err := keys.MarshalPrivatePEM(signer)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	_, prof, err := keys.ParsePrivatePEM(pemBytes)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(prof)
}
```

#### Output

```
ed25519
```

</p>
</details>
